institution.value: Ouranos Consortium on Regional Climatology and Adaptation to Climate Change

title.value: ESPO-G6-post2100 v1.0 : Ouranos Ensemble of Bias-adjusted Simulations - Global models post-2100

abstract.value: The need to adapt to climate change is present in a growing number of fields, leading to an increase in the demand for climate scenarios for often interrelated sectors of activity. In order to meet this growing demand and to ensure the availability of climate scenarios responding to numerous vulnerability, impact and adaptation (VIA) studies, Ouranos is working to create a set of operational bias-adjusted climate simulations called "Ensemble de simulations post-traitées d’Ouranos” (ESPO). The purpose of this dataset is to provide an ensemble extending to 2300 that can be used to assess long-term adaptation options.
